How we work with you

No mystery, no 60-slide decks. A clear four-step process that gets you from first call to live campaigns in about three weeks.

Audit

We review your website, ads, analytics and competitors, then show you exactly where money is being lost.

Plan

You get a 90-day plan with targets, budgets and the channels that suit your business best.

Launch

Our specialists build pages, ads and content, and set up tracking so every sale is measured.

Grow

We test, cut what doesn't work and invest more in what does, with a report you can actually read.

The people behind your growth

A senior team of 24 strategists, analysts, writers and designers. You always speak to the people doing the work.

Talk to us

Questions, answered

Can't find what you're looking for? Email hello@brightline.agency and a strategist will reply within one business day.

How long does it take to see results?

Paid ads can bring qualified traffic within the first two weeks. SEO usually shows clear movement in three to six months, depending on your competition and the state of your website.

Do you lock clients into long contracts?

No. After a 90-day starting period, every plan runs month to month with 30 days' notice. We'd rather earn your business every month.

What is the minimum ad budget?

We recommend at least $1,500 a month in ad spend so the platforms have enough data to optimise. We'll tell you honestly if a smaller budget won't work for your goals.

How do you report on performance?

You get a live dashboard, a written monthly report and a review call. We focus on revenue, cost per lead and what we'll do next, not vanity metrics.

Which industries do you work with?

E-commerce, SaaS, professional services, healthcare, hospitality and local businesses. We don't take on two direct competitors in the same city.

Let's find your next 100 customers.

Book a free 30-minute audit. We'll review your website and marketing, and you'll leave with three practical ideas you can use even if you never hire us.

  • Phone+1 (555) 014-2290
  • Studio88 Harbour Street, Toronto, ON M5J 2L1

We reply within one business day. No spam, ever.

# Digital Marketing Agency

Creator: mmrahmanbappi
Source: https://github.com/mmrahmanbappi/100-free-html-templates/blob/bab6ec6c8900450aab90989d217942a67ad9b16d/business/digital-marketing-agency/index.html

Extract the ZIP and open index.html. No build, npm dependencies or remote CDN is required.

The upstream/ folder preserves original source with its MIT notice. Root index.html is the separately documented MigBits adaptation.

Replace fictional sample business content, connect your own backend and retain the included license notices. Forms, data and payments are demonstrations.

Use Pause motion or your operating system reduced-motion preference. Full production and accessibility review remains your responsibility.

Original single-file HTML/CSS/inline JavaScript retained separately with creator MIT notice.

Stock photography, external fonts, favicons, metadata and remote services are excluded from the runnable edition; original HTML references are preserved as text only.

Original MigBits geometric demo artwork and motion controls are separate adaptations. Forms and checkout are frontend demonstrations, not backend services.

No React conversion is claimed. System font fallback changes the upstream typography. Render validation is not a complete accessibility audit.

Mobile grid minimum widths and word wrapping are corrected for community-center and nonprofit-charity. Dynamic photo references and initially empty image viewers use original artwork.

The original download-promotion toolbar is removed from runnable pages; creator attribution and complete copyright notices remain. Photo credit labels reflect the replacement MigBits artwork.
